List for final hearing in due course.
Also heard on I.A. No. 12854/2023, which is an application filed under Section 397 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of applicant.

2. The applicant has been convicted under Section 3(zz), 26 (2) (i) r/w Section 59 (1) of Food Safety and Standard Act of 2006 Sub-Rule 2011 and sentenced to undergo two months R.I with fine of Rs.10,000/- and usual default stipulations.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standard Act of 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5 . Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the Courts below have not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the applicant.

The samples of food which was collected by the Food Inspectors were in polythene bags,
whereas the Rule of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 prescribes that the samples should always be collected in containers, jars or bottles.
This revision would take considerable long time to dispose of finally.
Under these circumstances, looking to the short sentence, learned counsel prays that the application for suspension of sentence of the petitioner be allowed.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for dismissal of the application for suspension of sentence.
